title: Improve backend startup responsiveness
summary: Snapshot reads now return immediate initializing or cached evidence while a coalesced worker refreshes state; startup steps include timing, and WebView refreshes are scoped to the active page.
reason: Avoid snapshot lock contention and unnecessary initial WebView reads without weakening backend ownership or media safety boundaries.
behavior_before: A snapshot request synchronously rebuilt state and reconciled ActiveJobs, while WebView refreshes requested every page's read route at once.
behavior_after: Snapshot construction is cache-first and asynchronous, ActiveJobs reconciliation runs on a backend-owned cadence, startup timing is exposed in existing progress evidence, and WebView reads are limited to core plus the active page.

rollback_plan: Revert the listed backend, WebView, and generated-summary paths; the previous synchronous snapshot and all-page refresh behavior will be restored without media-state migration.
